# Rules Part C — Science + Platform Skills

Step 1 ke in sources se bane rules: 4 science files (Cutting, Smith, Zacks, Murch) +
Jakeschincariol youtube-agent-skill, SkillMedev skills, sergebulaev youtube-skills,
blazerior videoediting, pifferologo video-use.
Har rule: kab, kya, kyun, kitni baar — pure detail ke liye `rules_part_C.json` dekho.
Tags: 🟢 research se sabit · 🟡 measured/calibrated ya platform spec · 🟠 editor/house ki raay.

**Kul: 103 rules** — Kahani 33 · Samajh 9 · Rhythm 28 · Style 33
Saboot: 🟢 7 · 🟡 14 · 🟠 82 · Machine-checkable: 28 · Conflict notes: 32

## KAHANI (story / progress) — 33

- **C-011** Deliberate boundary = attention reset button 🟢 — naya section/reveal/topic par saaf situation change design karo, cut wahi lagao. [science_jeffrey_zacks]
- **C-012** Ek baar me ek hi dimension badlo 🟡 — place/people/goal/cause me se ek; hard reset sirf climax/chapter ke liye. [science_jeffrey_zacks]
- **C-013** Chunk = ek event 🟢 — har topic/step/scene exactly ek event, saaf shuruaat aur ant ke saath. [science_jeffrey_zacks]
- **C-014** Murch 1 — Emotion sabse upar (51%) 🟠 — emotion fail to cut reject; ⚠️ emotion check ENGINE KE BAHAR hai — aise cut human check ke liye flag honge. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-015** Murch 2 — Story aage badhe (23%) 🟠 — kahani rokne wala cut neeche ke criteria ke liye mat bachao. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-020** Murch meta 🟠 — pehle all-six wala cut; trade-off me qurbani neeche se upar (3-D pehle, emotion kabhi nahi). User ke Order se farak conflict note me hai. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-021** Greeting/intro se open kabhi nahi 🟠 — no "hey guys", no logo sting, no subscribe pitch hook se pehle. [Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev, sergebulaev]
- **C-022** Pehle 30s ki beat structure 🟠 — 0-3 cold line, 0:10 tak promise restate, 0:18 tak loop khula, 0:28 tak watch-contract; main point 2 min se pehle. ✔check: hook ≤30s. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev]
- **C-023** Hook ko score karo 🟡 — 5 properties (specificity, address, stakes, curiosity, brevity); verdict = 60% mean + 40% weakest; sabse kamzor fix karo. (hookscore 74 hooks par calibrated.) [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-025** Hook variants banao 🟠 — 5 likho, top 2 rakho; kam se kam 3 variants alag formulas se. [Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev]
- **C-026** Cold-open payoff tease 🟠 — result ka 3-8s flash pehle, phir setup. ✔check: 3-8s. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev]
- **C-027** Vaada imandari 🟡 — title/hook ka promise pehle 30s me sach me cash ho; over-promise = tez click-away ki saza. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev]
- **C-028** Promised artifact ≤20s me screen par 🟠. ✔check: 20s. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-029** Turn (0:15-0:45) 🟠 — ek sentence me plan, phir shuru; throat-clearing hi 0:30 cliff hai. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-031** Har beat: mini-hook + delivery + bridge 🟠 — kisi bhi pal ≥1 open loop zinda. ✔check: min 1 loop. [SkillMedev]
- **C-032** Midpoint re-engagement trigger 🟠 — beech me "but here's the thing" wala mod/stakes-raise. [SkillMedev]
- **C-035** Payoff over-deliver 🟠 — recap ek-ek sentence + hook me na bataya bonus insight; abrupt end nahi. [SkillMedev, Jakeschincariol]
- **C-036** Ek hi CTA 🟠 — topic se juda ek specific ask, subscribe-like-bell string kabhi nahi. [Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev, sergebulaev]
- **C-037** Shorts spoken hook <12 shabd 🟠. ✔check: max 12 words. [SkillMedev]
- **C-040** Short = self-contained 20-55s moment 🟠 — complete thought se khule, turn ho, line par khatm; nayi pehli line likho. ✔check: 20-55s. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-050** Paach-beat spine (demo) 🟠 — Hook(3s, logo nahi) → Problem → Reveal → Proof (asli number hi) → CTA(ek). [SkillMedev]
- **C-052** Causality order 🟠 — beats "therefore/but" se judein, "and then" ki chain = sag. [SkillMedev]
- **C-053** Load-bearing turns ki jagah 🟠 — inciting 10-12%, act break 20-25%, midpoint ~50%, all-is-lost 75-80%. [SkillMedev]
- **C-054** Setups/payoffs audit 🟠 — har payoff pehle plant ho, har setup ya pay off ya cut; coincidence bachaye kabhi nahi. [SkillMedev]
- **C-055** Tension curve 🟠 — overall chadhai + jaanboojh ki ghaatiyan; do barabar beats = ek ko vary/reorder. [SkillMedev]
- **C-056** Thesis-breakdown format 🟠 — monologue ke runtime hisse: hook 0-8% … climax 77-86%, ending 86-100%. [blazerior]
- **C-065** Hafte ka mix 🟠 — stage-wise LF+Shorts ratio; cadence 12 hafte nibhne layak; anchor + cheap + anchor-se-Shorts; slip ho to Short chhodo. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol]
- **C-066** Community posts 🟠 — pehli line hook, ek ask, poll 2-4 options, hafte me 2-4 posts. [sergebulaev]
- **C-068** Comments se next video 🟠 — 3+ baar dohraya sawaal = video candidate; pin sabke sawaal ko, pyare wale ko nahi. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol]
- **C-069** Repurpose 🟠 — spine (ek claim) nikalo, payoff se lead, listicle→chapters, off-platform artifacts strip; facts kabhi na badlo. [sergebulaev]
- **C-070** Outlier research 🟠 — channel ke apne median ka multiple (1.5-2x+); 4 se kam videos wala channel skip. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-094** Peaks ki hifazat 🟠 — laugh/punchline ke aage reaction tak extend karo; audio events beats ke signal hain. [pifferologo]
- **C-103** Structural archetypes 🟠 — launch/tutorial/interview/travel/documentary/music ke ready shapes; beats clip order se nahi, beat order se jodo. [pifferologo]

## SAMAJH (clarity) — 9

- **C-007** Ek shot = ek hi attentional magnet 🟢 — face/motion/awaaz me se ek; competing motion hatao. [science_tim_smith]
- **C-030** Ek beat = ek idea 🟠 — har beat ke saath on-screen kya dikhega, ye bhi mark karo. [Jakeschincariol, SkillMedev]
- **C-046** Chapters ke platform niyam 🟡 — pehla 00:00, ≥3 chapters, har ≥10s; title 3-5 shabdon me section ka promise. [Jakeschincariol, sergebulaev]
- **C-048** Narration-action sync 🟠 — ek action = ek instruction; shabd action ke saath land hon; complex visual par chup raho. [SkillMedev]
- **C-049** Step shape: Goal → Action → Confirmation 🟠 — UI labels bilkul wasi bolo jaisa button par likha hai. [SkillMedev]
- **C-064** Likhne ki safaai 🟠 — em dash ≤1/100 shabd; AI-shabd 3+/paragraph = rewrite; sincerity openers banned; keyword stuffing nahi. [sergebulaev]
- **C-085** Phrase captions ke reading niyam 🟠 — cue ~1-7s, 1-2 lines, 32-42 chars/line, ≤17 chars/sec, clause par break; raw ASR kabhi ship nahi. ✔check: line ≤42 chars. [SkillMedev]
- **C-095** Sirf word-level verbatim ASR 🟠 — phrase/SRT mode nahi, filler normalize nahi; transcript ki pehli-aakhri line khud padho (hallucination). [pifferologo, blazerior]
- **C-102** Self-eval gate 🟠 — rendered output har cut boundary ±1.5s par check; max 3 passes, phir khamiyan flag karo. [pifferologo]

## RHYTHM (timing / pacing) — 28

- **C-001** ASL band 3-6s 🟡 — do minute se lambi video ka average shot 3-6s; average mehsoos karo, har shot band me nahi. ✔check: avg 3-6s. [science_james_cutting]
- **C-002** Metronome pe kaatna nahi 🟡 — shot lengths me 1/f jaisa lamba-chhota mix; baar-baar bilkul barabar lengths jagaye hue AI jaisi feel. [science_james_cutting]
- **C-003** Climax par compression 🟡 — katne ki gati chadhai ke saath badhe, barabar lambai ka hook/peak kabhi nahi failta; par climax khud photo-audio balance se, shot-ghatao se nahi. (⚠️ pattern partly UNVERIFIED — abstract tak hi dekha.) [science_james_cutting]
- **C-005** Cut movement par, harkat tak rakho 🟢 — movement finish/shuru par; stand-up/sit-down/object reach wala mid-motion cut natural. [science_tim_smith]
- **C-006** Eye-trace landing 🟢 — cut ke baad dhyaan seedha key element par; naya key element pichli nazar wali jagah rakho. [science_tim_smith]
- **C-008** Speed ki manovaigyanik hadd 🟡 — subject detectability ke neeche mat jao; human-centred <50ms = bata bhi nahi sakte, ~200ms+ dissolve jaisa padhta hai. [science_tim_smith]
- **C-009** Cut wahi jahan situation badle 🟢 — place/time/people/goal/cause/focus ke change par; mid-event random cut kabhi nahi. [science_jeffrey_zacks]
- **C-010** Mid-event flow ki hifazat 🟢 — action ke beech hard cut/zoom/transition nahi, ek hi event ka hissa padhe. [science_jeffrey_zacks]
- **C-016** Murch 3 — Rhythm (10%) 🟠 — timing feel story ke neeche; sahi rhythm story ko kabhi nahi harata. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-017** Murch 4 — Eye-trace (7%) 🟠 — audience ki nazar jahan hai, cut ke baad focus wahi se mile; nazar ki harkat ko flow me rakho. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-033** Pattern interrupt har 90-120s 🟠 — location/angle/energy/pacing me reset. ⚠️ Dusre clusters se cadence takraav Step 3 me. ✔check: max gap 120s. [SkillMedev]
- **C-034** Section break par re-hook 🟠 — naya visual + naya open loop, heading-only break kabhi nahi. [SkillMedev]
- **C-038** Shorts overlay pehle frame par 🟠 — kicker + title saath, 5-7 shabd, 4s ke andar chaaho to fade. ✔check: overlay ≤4s. [SkillMedev]
- **C-039** Frame one sound-off par kaam kare 🟠 — pehli line burned caption ke roop me bhi dikhe. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-041** Shorts loop design 🟠 — aakhri line pehli me bandhe (2-3 shabd loop-back); "wait for it" aur kasht-kar rewind nahi. [Jakeschincariol, sergebulaev]
- **C-042** Dead-air trim, floor 0.45s 🟠 — 0.45s se lamba gap beech se kaato (punch-in nahi). ✔check: max speech gap 0.45s. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-043** Sirf filler cut karke cues banao 🟠 — 'so'/'well' jaise discourse markers rakho; sub-silence repetitive filler ka DSLR-risk flag karo. [SkillMedev]
- **C-044** Retake pe restart point 🟠 — retake pehle 5 shabdon me match kare to poora, warna version 1 hi. [SkillMedev]
- **C-045** Retention ke 3 bimari-pattern 🟠 — hook leak (<25% @0:30 = hook fail), cliff (badalav fail), slide (beech sag); diagnose karke knob badlo. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-071** Cut phrase ke end par 🟠 — stopwatch par nahi; moving subject par cut na ho to card dhako. [blazerior]
- **C-072** Har pause ka 0.2-0.3s bacha rakho 🟠. ✔check: min gap 0.2s. [blazerior]
- **C-073** Dramatic pause ko haath mat lagao 🟠 — wahan khamoshi hi kaam hai. [blazerior]
- **C-082** Panel rhythm 2-8s 🟠 — beech me 0.3-1s saaf frame, 8-12 panels/min, ek type back-to-back nahi. ✔check: panel 2-8s. [blazerior]
- **C-089** Har segment boundary par 30ms audio fade 🟠 — 20ms se neeche click, 50ms se upar dip. ✔check: 30ms. [pifferologo, blazerior]
- **C-090** Shabd ke beech cut kabhi nahi 🟠 — har edge word boundary par snap. [pifferologo]
- **C-091** Cut edge padding 30-200ms 🟠 — ASR drift socheta hai; fast=tight, cinematic=loose. ✔check: 30-200ms. [pifferologo]
- **C-092** Silence thresholds 🟠 — ≥400ms saaf cut, 150-400ms visual check ke saath, <150ms unsafe. ✔check: clean silence ≥0.4s. [pifferologo]
- **C-093** Speaker handoff me 400-600ms hawa 🟠. ✔check: 0.4-0.6s. [pifferologo]
- **C-101** Animation ka payoff bolne wale shabd par land kare 🟠 — overlay reveal_duration pehle shuru. [pifferologo]

## STYLE (look / effect / packaging) — 33

- **C-004** Declutter framing 🟡 — face ke aas-paas <2 saaf elements; busy background, text-heavy screens, fast-moving subjects hatao (Cutting ka clutter wala data 🟢, corollary mera/samasya ka 🟡). [science_james_cutting]
- **C-018** Murch 5 — 2-D plane (5%) 🟠 — frame ki sataah par sambandh saaf; horizontal flip kabhi bina check ke nahi. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-019** Murch 6 — 3-D space (4%) 🟠 — screen direction consistent; 180° todna sirf deliberate disorientation ke liye. [science_walter_murch]
- **C-024** Hook ki lambai 9-24 shabd 🟡 — 3-7 = chunky (risk), 25-40 = long (risk), >40 = poem territory. (74-hook calibration.) ✔check: 9-24 words. [Jakeschincariol]
- **C-047** Bolne ki gati budget 150 wpm 🟠 — hard limit nahi (115-200); narration 140-160; torso ke neeche hawa ke liye slack rakho. [SkillMedev]
- **C-051** Scene-type ki mazboot duratin 🟠 — cold open 3-8s, explainer 15-30s, demo 30-90s, review 45-120s, outro 5-10s (saturated to 3-5s). [SkillMedev]
- **C-057** Title formulas 🟡 — Y1/Y3/Y5 corpus-validated over-performers (214-video pull); Y2/Y4/Y6 niche-dependent — conflict note dekho. [sergebulaev]
- **C-058** Title lambai/front-load 🟡 — hard cap 100 chars, sweet spot 40-60; click shabd truncation se pehle. ✔check: ≤100 chars. [Jakeschincariol, sergebulaev]
- **C-059** Title samagri 🟠 — number/naam/date; vague adjectives out; all-caps par sources me halka farak (conflict note). [Jakeschincariol, sergebulaev]
- **C-060** Thumbnail core 🟠 — ek focal point, emotion video se match, contrast/separation, 120px test, ≤3 elements. [sergebulaev, SkillMedev, Jakeschincariol]
- **C-061** Thumbnail text 🟠 — title se alag shabd, target 3. ⚠️ LIMIT TAKRAAV: Jake 3 max / serge ≤4 / SkillMedev 2-5 (target 3). ✔check: ≤3 words. [Jakeschincariol, sergebulaev, SkillMedev]
- **C-062** Thumbnail 2-3 concepts 🟠 — ek bada element vary; jeet watch-time share se naapo. [sergebulaev, SkillMedev]
- **C-063** Description 🟡 — pehle 150 chars = dusra hook + keyword; cap 5000; hashtags 3-5 (15+ = sab ignore); tags ≤15. ✔check: ≤5000 chars. [sergebulaev, Jakeschincariol]
- **C-067** Channel page 🟠 — trailer 30-90s, banner safe area 1235×338 centred, About ki pehli 2 lines me value prop. [sergebulaev]
- **C-074** Zoom alternate karo 🟠 — 1.00/1.045/1.09 pattern, climax par max. [blazerior]
- **C-075** Ek graphics-free stretch per minute 🟠 — 4-6s saaf hawa lazmi. [blazerior]
- **C-076** Card face ke UPAR 🟠 — safe zones: top 0-150 kuch nahi, graphics 200-1250, subtitles 1380-1520, bottom 1600-1920 kuch nahi. [blazerior]
- **C-077** Word-level subtitles 🟠 — line ≤3 shabd, 0.7s gap = nayi line, active shabd tint + 108% scale, font 72, WrapStyle 0. ✔check: ≤3 words. [blazerior]
- **C-078** Loudness −14 LUFS 🟡 — I=-14, TP=-1.5, LRA=11 (platform standard). ✔check: −14±1. [blazerior]
- **C-079** Grade tulna karke chuno 🟠 — candidate frames hstack karke side-by-side; 8-bit par moderate (banding). [blazerior]
- **C-080** Base grade recipe 🟠 — contrast 1.13, sat 1.07, gamma 1.07, shadows uthaye hue, vignette PI/9 (tested values). [blazerior]
- **C-081** Transitions 🟠 — hard cut default, xfade 0.3s sirf movement par; xfade baad ki timings shift karta hai. ✔check: xfade 0.3s. [blazerior]
- **C-083** Design restraint 🟠 — ≤2 accent rang, type floor 36px, neon/4px outlines nahi, panel shadow lazmi. [blazerior]
- **C-084** Animation restraint 🟠 — 0.25s fade kaafi; fly-in/bounce nahi. [blazerior]
- **C-086** Social export 🟠 — captions burned-in, platform insets (TikTok 6/11/17/3, Reels 7/12/18/3, Shorts 5/12/13/3...); 9:16 master sabse tang inset par. [SkillMedev]
- **C-087** Reframe seedhi 🟠 — re-layout > punch-and-track > center crop > blur-pad; moving subject par blind center crop kabhi nahi. [SkillMedev]
- **C-088** Subtitles filter chain me LAST 🟠 — warna overlays dhak dete hain, silent failure. [pifferologo]
- **C-096** Per-segment extract → lossless concat 🟠 — grade per-segment; single-pass double-encode nahi. [pifferologo]
- **C-097** Grade CDL se 🟠 — slope/offset/power/sat; EK badlav, phir dekho; skin tones test bina aggressive nahi. [pifferologo]
- **C-098** Subtitle chunking ke 2 style 🟠 — bold-overlay (2-shabd, UPPERCASE, MarginV 35) / natural-sentence (4-7 shabd, MarginV 60-80). ✔check: bold chunk ≤2 words. [pifferologo]
- **C-099** Animation muddatein 🟠 — explanation cards 5-7s (floor 3s), diagrams 8-14s, accents 0.5-2s, final frame ≥1s hold, overlay ≥ narration+1s. ✔check: card 5-7s. [pifferologo]
- **C-100** Easing cubic 🟠 — linear kabhi nahi; do independent elements parallel reveal kabhi nahi. [pifferologo]

## ⚠️ TAKRAAV (Step 3 me suljhana hoga)

1. **Murch vs User Order** — Murch: Emotion (51) > Story (23). User: Kahani sabse upar, emotion engine ke bahar (human eye). C-014/C-020 me conflict note hai; faisla Step 3 ka hai.
2. **Thumbnail text limit** — Jake 3 max / serge ≤4 / SkillMedev 2-5 (target 3). C-061.
3. **Title all-caps** — Jake ≤2 caps shabd / serge full-caps banned, 1 emphasis shabd. C-059.
4. **Pause/gap model** — teen bhashayein: Jake floor 0.45s trim-middle (C-042), blazerior remainder 0.2-0.3s (C-072), pifferologo silence ≥400ms + edge padding 30-200ms (C-091/C-092). Numbers takraate nahi lekin model ek banna chahiye.
5. **Caption modes** — word-level 3 shabd (C-077) vs phrase 32-42 chars (C-085) vs 2-shabd chunks (C-098): content-type se batega.
6. **Pattern-interrupt cadence** — is cluster me SkillMedev 90-120s (C-033); dusre clusters se (CraigHewitt/slopstudio) takraav Step 3 me aayega.
7. **Climax compression (C-003)** — pattern ka pura saboot abstract tak hi dekha gaya; baaki Cutting file poori padhi gayi, lekin ye wala dawa UNVERIFIED-in-full hai.
